source: Fuls, Andreas (2023), A Catalog of Indus Signs (Mathematica Epigraphica) — held print PDF on the owner's desktop (PROVENANCE entry 27; PDF sha256 31729a4f..., 274,176,439 bytes); consulted through 120-dpi page renders produced on the desktop with ghostscript and read back page by page. The OCR text of the volume was used as a locator only and never governs a statement.

sign_list_ch2_3.agreement_with_corpus_inventory: the list's 713 codes equal the Shakti corpus's 713 distinct codes except: 275 is listed but unattested in the corpus; 999 is attested in the corpus (a placeholder token) but not a listed sign

concordance_2_5_parpola.finding: The concordance's P94 column is Parpola (1994)'s own sign numbering, which is NOT the registry's parpola_1982 (CISI) numbering: the two are different arrangements of Parpola's list. Proven from the volume itself: section 2.4's Mahadevan column matches the CISI digitization's mahadevan/wells cross-references exactly at every spot checked (M012->151, M016->123, M008->100, M020->131, M038->{94,136}), while section 2.5's rows align with the CISI numbering at only a minority of signs. Section 2.5 therefore states no completion a Registry v2 row can carry (its numbers name no registry row), and no completion is entered from it. Its placements for the five named codes are recorded: 136 -> Parpola (1994) sign 6 (p. 45); 298 -> sign 217 (p. 47); 401 -> sign 107 (p. 46); 617 -> sign 272 (p. 48); 824 -> sign 373 (p. 49). Each of the five sits in exactly one section 2.5 row and one section 2.4 row, with consistent clusters; no conflicting identity statement exists for any frame code.

concordance_2_4_mahadevan: Mahadevan 1977 is struck as a governing source for this study (freeze ruling OPEN-073-1); section 2.4 was used only as a numbering diagnostic, never as an identity source.

sources_searched: Catalog Ch. 2.3 sign list (glyphs only, no verbal descriptions)
Catalog Ch. 2 prose and Ch. 3 (positional and form discussions only: 'doubled grapheme', 'mirrored', position classes)
Catalog section 5.1 entries (occurrence and positional data; no depictions)
Fuls 2023 Corpus of Indus Inscriptions prose (13 sign mentions, all positional/orientation)
CISI 3.1 (no sign list; basic tables carry no sign transcriptions)
Parpola 2010 lecture (identifications for Parpola-keyed signs only; not a numbered list reaching these codes)
depiction_hunt_for_icit_only_codes.result: No ruled published source gives a verbal depiction for any ICIT-only code. Every such sign's Asset A v2 row is therefore 'unidentified' with this search recorded.

contested_identity.basis: no frame code is claimed by two registry rows; the Catalog's concordances place each of the five named codes in exactly one row of each concordance with mutually consistent clusters; the CISI digitization and the Catalog nowhere state conflicting identities for the same code.
